name: SVC_COLLAB_ACTIONS
description: This table holds the information on the valid slack action and rest resources. ACTION_ID is the primary key in this table.

columns.name: COLLAB_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CATALOG_CD
columns.description: Stores the rest catalog root context.

columns.name: STATUS_CD
columns.description: This is the status code of the collaboration action.

columns.name: COLLAB_ACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Auto-generated unique number with customizable format.

columns.name: PARENT_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Refers to the parent action of this action.

columns.name: COLLAB_ACTION_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the slack command, for example: /ec-my-opportunities.

columns.name: COLLAB_ACTION_CD
columns.description: Code used for collaboration action.

columns.name: COLLAB_ACTION_METHOD
columns.description: Command issued from slack for interacton with the engagement cloud.

columns.name: COLLAB_ACTION_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Type of the slack command, example:INVOKE_DIALOG, INVOKE_API.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the object, example ServiceRequest, Opportunity, this action is associated with.

columns.name: NEXT_ACTION_CD
columns.description: Code of the action such as action associated with submit dialog.

columns.name: RESPONSE_ENTITY_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Type of the response entity. Example JSON/OBJECT.

columns.name: RESPONSE_MSG_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Visibility of the response message, for example PUBLIC or PRIVATE.

columns.name: REQUEST_END_POINT
columns.description: Command method describing whether its a get or put.

columns.name: REQUEST_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Content of the slack request payload in JSON format.

columns.name: RESPONSE_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the payload, example [application/json].

columns.name: REQUEST_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Content of the slack request payload in JSON format.

columns.name: RESPONSE_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Content of the slack response payload in JSON format.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the message is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CONTROL_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Type of the action control; for example: button.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The sequence in which actions appear in collaboration message.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referring to SVC_CHANNELS_B.CHANNEL_ID.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the collaboration action.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
